description: Mirage IIIEA c/n 2F/2A delivered 1 November 1972, retired 29 November 2015; trucked from Tandil 5 August 2021 and unveiled 21 August 2021 as a memorial to Capt. Gustavo García Cuerva, a native of Dolores lost on 1 May 1982. Photographed October 2021 and 27 May 2024.
museum_name: Mirage IIIEA García Cuerva Monument, Dolores
